contract: Private daily-use agent workspace: immediate Claude connection, one visible conversation, a narrow sidebar, a central streaming chat, and a collapsible configuration drawer. Quiet graphite, ivory and mint controls with warm Claude accents. Primary actions: connect a key and send a message. Preserve readable controls, visible focus and independent chat scrolling at 1440x900 and 390x844. Local references: user-approved stage-one plan and verification/REPORT.md.

accessibility.evidence: Axe WCAG A/AA checks passed on desktop/mobile onboarding and desktop empty chat. Labelled controls, keyboard focus visibility, Escape dialog dismissal and reduced-motion rules checked; screenshots inspected. Full assistive technology certification is outside this check.

responsive.evidence: Inspected 1440x900 and 390x844 captures. Mobile navigation collapses, conversation composer remains available, settings fit the viewport, and document scrollWidth does not exceed innerWidth.

loading.evidence: Initial workspace loading and provider Test connection pending states display progress. Streaming exposes Stop.

empty.evidence: Fresh database displays provider onboarding; a connected empty conversation displays starter prompts and the composer.

error.evidence: Invalid-key and provider-outage browser checks display actionable errors; failed replacement keeps the working key.

partial.evidence: Stopped generation retains partial text; missing costs remain unavailable and model discovery fallback is labelled.

success.evidence: Connection success shows Connected and last four characters; opening the workspace, saving settings and copying/removing keys expose confirmation feedback.

permission.evidence: Account-mode browser checks require login, validate failed credentials and return to login on logout. Cross-account integration checks deny access to another user's data.

renderedEvidence.observation: Readable provider form, persistent local navigation and a numbered setup guide; no external assets.
Collapsed navigation, wrapping Markdown/code, visible stopped response and composer; no horizontal page overflow.
